title: Moroccan Chicken and Chickpea Skillet with Quinoa
intro: Cinnamon is typically reserved for baking, but in North African cooking, it brings a warm, savory depth that transforms a simple pan sauce. Built with pre-cooked quinoa and tender chicken, this braise delivers complex flavors without demanding hours on the stove.

ingredients.name: Chicken tenderloins
ingredients.canonical_name: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw

ingredients.name: No-salt-added diced tomatoes, with juice
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice, no salt added

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned chickpeas
ingredients.canonical_name: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water

instructions: Toss the chicken in a medium bowl with the ground cumin, smoked paprika, ground cinnamon, and salt until evenly coated.
Heat the extra-virgin olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned on the bottom, 3 to 4 minutes.
Flip the chicken and add the minced garlic to the skillet. Stir and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour the diced tomatoes with their juices, rinsed chickpeas, and cooked quinoa into the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and cook until the chicken is completely opaque and the quinoa is warmed, 5 to 6 minutes.
Remove the lid and stir in the baby spinach. Cook until the spinach wilts, 1 to 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat, stir in the fresh lemon juice, and divide between two plates.
variation: Swap the chicken for turkey breast or boneless pork loin.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat gently on the stovetop.
validation_warnings: Stage 4 qualifier: 'No-salt-added canned chickpeas': the recipe uses a canned product but the match is cooked from dry (different water content, so a different weight basis) — switched from [173757] Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt to [175250] Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, solids and liquids, low sodium.
